Messages.Author: Millicent
Messages.Body:
Hi, I have a 9 cap vampire with Secure Haven and my pool is at 1.

Can I pay the cost of a Golconda: Inner Peace on my 9 cap vamp and still remain in play at the end of the resolution ?

Secure Haven
Unique location. Haven.
Put this card on a minion you control. This minion cannot be the target of other Methuselahs' actions. Master cards targeting this minion cost 1 additional pool. Burn this card after this minion goes to torpor. A minion can have only one haven.

Golconda: Inner Peace
Remove a vampire with capacity 8 or more from the game. Their controller gains pool equal to the vampire's capacity. Their controller can burn 2 pool to cancel this card as it is played.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Yes. See also Eternals of Sirius while at 4 pool.
